# PetBacker

> PetBacker is a global pet services marketplace connecting pet parents with vetted sitters, dog walkers, and boarding providers across multiple countries.

PetBacker operates as a peer-to-peer pet care platform in over a dozen countries including the UK, Singapore, Hong Kong, Germany, Malaysia, Australia, Ireland, and Spain. The platform offers comprehensive pet services including home boarding, pet sitting, dog walking, and grooming with built-in trust and safety features.

## Key Topics

- Pet Sitting
- Dog Boarding
- Dog Walking
- Home Boarding
- Pet Grooming
- Pet Services Marketplace
- Pet Care Platform
